devdoc.author: TB_Contracts Team
devdoc.details: This contract serves as the central hub for storing and retrieving      addresses of all protocol contracts. It provides a single source of      truth for contract addresses and allows for easy updates when contracts      are upgraded or redeployed.

OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

changeStrategyAsset(address).details: Gets pool address from Uniswap V3 factory for new asset / WETH pair, then calls changeAsset on StrategyThen calls updateAsset() on Vault and SwapRouter to update their referencesOnly callable by the owner or Demeter

constructor.details: Sets the deployer as the owner of the contract

deleteAddress(string).details: Sets the address to address(0) and emits an AddressDeleted event.

params._name: The name of the contract whose address should be deleted.
The name of the contract whose address is being requested.

returns._0: The address associated with the given name, or address(0) if not set.

params._names: Array of contract names to get addresses for.

returns._0: Array of addresses corresponding to the names.

params._name: The name of the contract to check.

returns._0: True if an address is set (non-zero), false otherwise.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setAddress(string,address).details: Emits AddressSet every time, and AddressUpdated if the address changes from a nonzero value.Validates that the address is not zero address.

params._address: The address to associate with the given name.
params._name: The name of the contract to set the address for.

setAddresses(string[],address[]).details: Batch operation that calls setAddress for each name-address pair.

params._addresses: Array of addresses corresponding to the names.
params._names: Array of contract names to set addresses for.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

addresses.details: Keys are contract names (e.g., "Oracle", "Rewards", "TerminalBank")      Values are the corresponding contract addresses

devdoc.title: ContractManager

addresses(string).notice: Mapping of contract names to their addresses

changeStrategyAsset(address).notice: Changes the asset in the Strategy contract and updates all related contracts

deleteAddress(string).notice: Deletes the address associated with a given contract name. Only callable by the owner.

getAddress(string).notice: Retrieves the address associated with a given contract name.

getAddresses(string[]).notice: Retrieves multiple contract addresses in a single call.

isAddressSet(string).notice: Checks if an address is set for a given contract name.

setAddress(string,address).notice: Sets the address for a given contract name. Only callable by the owner.

setAddresses(string[],address[]).notice: Sets multiple contract addresses in a single transaction. Only callable by the owner.

userdoc.notice: Central registry for managing protocol contract addresses
